sources.title: Shoe Dog: A Memoir by the Creator of Nike
sources.quote_checked: History is one long processional of crazy ideas. | I'd tell men and women in their midtwenties not to settle for a job or a profession or even a career. Seek a calling. | Life is growth. You grow or you die. | Hard work is critical, a good team is essential, brains and determination are invaluable, but luck may decide the outcome.
